Pharmacovigilance in the context of [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] focuses heavily on monitoring the safety and efficacy of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation therapy). A primary concern in treating atrial fibrillation is balancing the prevention of thromboembolic events, such as [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke), against the risk of severe bleeding complications, notably [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial bleeding) and [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding).

National registry data from 2023 to 2025 provides continuous pharmacovigilance comparing Direct Oral Anticoagulants ([[doac|DOAC]], also referred to as NOAC) with the traditional vitamin K antagonist [[marevan|marevan]]. In 2023, the overall proportion of patients experiencing intracranial bleeding was 0.52% for DOAC and 0.46% for marevan [^src1]. When looking specifically at atrial fibrillation patients, the rates were 0.52% for NOAC and 0.46% for marevan [^src2]. 

By 2024, the data showed a shift in these safety profiles. The rate of intracranial bleeding was recorded at 0.53% for DOAC and 0.82% for marevan [^src3], suggesting a relative safety advantage for DOACs in this specific metric. Similarly, the proportion of patients suffering from severe bleeding was 2.30% for DOAC compared to 2.38% for marevan [^src4]. Furthermore, pharmacovigilance extends to treatment coverage and efficacy; nationally, 65.5% of atrial fibrillation patients admitted with an ischemic stroke or stroke of unknown type had redeemed a prescription for oral anticoagulation within 100 days prior to admission [^src5].

The most recent 2025 data continues this comparative monitoring. The rate of ischemic stroke was nearly identical between the two treatments, at 0.86% for DOAC and 0.88% for marevan [^src6]. However, the rates of intracranial bleeding showed 0.57% for DOAC [^src7] and 0.63% for marevan [^src7]. These ongoing observations are critical for clinical decision-making, ensuring that the benefits of stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation are not outweighed by the risks of life-threatening hemorrhages.

## Claims
- Andelen af patienter med intrakraniel blødning er 0,52% for DOAC og 0,46% for marevan [^src1] (doac, marevan)
- For patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog NOAC-behandling, var andelen af intrakraniel blødning 0,52 % [^src1] (doac, intrakraniel-bloedning)
- For patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog Marevan-behandling, var andelen af intrakraniel blødning 0,46 % [^src1] (marevan, intrakraniel-bloedning)
- Andelen af patienter med intrakraniel blødning er 0,53% for DOAC og 0,82% for marevan [^src1] (doac, marevan, intrakraniel-bloedning)
- Andelen af patienter med alvorlig blødning er 2,30% for DOAC og 2,38% for marevan [^src1] (doac, marevan, alvorlig-bloedning)
- Andelen af atrieflimren-patienter indlagt med iskæmisk apopleksi/apopleksi af ukendt type, som havde indløst recept på oral antikoagulationsbehandling inden for 100 dage før indlæggelsen, var 65,5 % på nationalt plan [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, iskaemisk-apopleksi, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- Andelen af patienter med iskæmisk apopleksi er 0,86% for DOAC og 0,88% for marevan [^src1] (doac, marevan)
- Andelen af patienter med intrakraniel blødning er 0,57 % for DOAC [^src1] (doac, intrakraniel-bloedning)
- Andelen af patienter med intrakraniel blødning er 0,63% for marevan [^src1] (marevan, intrakraniel-bloedning)
